facts.target: empty: one result per host

data.os: distribution name and version (NAME and VERSION_ID of /etc/os-release), when readable

facts.target: empty: one result per host
facts.value: memory available to programs, % of total (MemAvailable)

data.available: MemAvailable in bytes (MemFree + Buffers + Cached on kernels before 3.14)

facts.target: empty: one result per host
facts.value: swap in use, % of total; 0 without swap

facts.target: empty: one result per host

data.cpu: % of the last minute some tasks waited for CPU (some avg60)

facts.target: empty: one result per host
facts.value: processes the kernel killed for lack of memory in the last 24 hours

data.procs: names of the killed processes, at most 10 distinct

facts.target: mount point of a local, device-backed filesystem (each device once)

data.ipct: inodes used, %; 0 when the filesystem has no fixed inode table

facts.target: path of a log file over 500 MiB in /var/log, /var/lib/docker/containers or <project folder>/storage/logs; empty with value 0 when none; a folder the SSH user cannot enter (needs_perm)
a project folder on this host (path component)
facts.value: disk usage of the folder without skip paths (du -x)

data.files: largest files over the Settings floor (DAMINUS_LARGE_FILE_MB), [relative path, bytes], at most 10
data.partial: true when du could not read every subfolder

facts.target: empty: one result per host; no result without docker
facts.value: total size of images, containers, volumes and build cache

facts.target: compose project name (label com.docker.compose.project)

data.containers: containers of the project, one-off runs excluded (0: none left, the project is down)
data.not_running: containers not running, except ones that exited 0 with restart policy 'no'
data.mem_pct: highest container memory use, % of its limit, or of host memory for a container without a limit (docker stats MemPerc)
data.services: per container {name, svc (compose service), state, restarts, mem (bytes), limit (bytes, 0: none), cpu (%), oom, exit, started, image}

facts.target: pm2 app name

data.status: worst instance status (online, stopped, errored…); 'stopped' when the daemon does not run
data.daemon: whether the pm2 daemon of this PM2_HOME runs

facts.target: database name (database component)
facts.value: size of the database (MySQL: data + index length from information_schema, cached by the server for up to 24 h; Postgres: pg_database_size). With a container set on the component the server inside it is asked, whatever host and port the .env holds

facts.target: name of a running process that is a known miner, or runs from a deleted file in a temp-type folder; empty with value 0 when none and every process was seen

data.seen: processes whose executable could be read (kernel threads and zombies are not counted)
data.total: processes that could be inspected at all; seen < total means another user's processes were out of reach (Unknown needs_perm when nothing was found)
data.exe: path of the executable, with " (deleted)" when its file is gone
data.deleted: whether the executable file was deleted
data.why: name (a known miner name) or deleted (runs from a deleted file in /tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm, /run, /dev or memfd)

facts.target: path of a PHP file inside an uploads or storage/app/public folder of a project folder; the project folder itself with value 0 when it has none

data.total: files found in the project folder (at most the 50 newest are listed)

checks.fp: size:mtime:sha12, the SHA-256 of the first MiB

facts.target: path of an executable file in /tmp, /var/tmp or /dev/shm (depth 4); empty with value 0 when none

data.total: files found (at most the 50 newest are listed)

checks.fp: size:mtime:sha12, the SHA-256 of the first MiB

facts.target: /etc/ld.so.preload when it lists libraries; empty with value 0 when the file is absent or empty

checks.fp: size:mtime:sha12, the SHA-256 of the file

facts.target: port number (3306, 5432, 6379, 27017 or 2375) listening on 0.0.0.0 or ::; empty with value 0 when none

data.proc: name of the process holding it, empty when it is not the SSH user's

facts.target: a project folder on this host (path component)
facts.value: code files changed in the last 3 days, without vendor, node_modules, storage, .git and the skip paths

data.newest: change time of the newest, unix seconds
data.files: the 10 newest, [path relative to the folder, mtime]

checks.fp: SHA-256 of the sorted file names

facts.target: the project URL as configured
facts.value: milliseconds until the response headers; none on a network failure

data.class: 2xx … 5xx, other, or error when no response came
data.final: last URL after redirects, without query, fragment or credentials; only when it differs
data.error: dns, no_route, refused, timeout, tls, redirects, invalid_url or other; only when class is error

facts.target: the project URL as configured (https only)
facts.value: days until the certificate's notAfter, to two decimals; negative once expired. Read even when the certificate is expired, self-signed or for another name

data.expired: today is outside the validity period
data.untrusted: the operating system's trust store refuses the chain for a reason other than the date or the name
data.mismatch: the certificate is not valid for the host name
data.error: only on an unknown result: dns, no_route, refused, timeout, tls or certificate

facts.target: the project URL as configured; /.env and /.git/HEAD are asked for at the root of its site
facts.value: how many of the two files can be downloaded (0: looked, found none)

data.exposed: at least one file is served
data.matched_keys: what showed the file to be one: key names like /.env:DB_PASSWORD, or /.git/HEAD:ref; never a value or any of the body
data.error: only on an unknown result: timeout, or why no answer came
